versions.content: DoIP messages shall be bi-directionally routed Description: DoIP shall implement a mechanism to bi-directionally route DoIP messages between the vehicle networks and TCP sockets. Rationale: This is necessary to allow DoIP communication Use Case: – AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: [1] ISO13400-2
